Instructions for Use
Device description: The Quartz Neurostimulation System is a spinal cord stimulation system. It is available in lengths from 12 mm to 28 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) Safety Information
The Quartz Neurostimulation System is MR Conditional. Patients with this device can be scanned at 1.5-Tesla and 3.0-Tesla when all of the following conditions are met.
General conditions:
- a maximum spatial field gradient of 3 T/m (300 gauss/cm).
- Scan in Normal Operating Mode.
- head transmit/receive coil only.
- Receive with the head transmit/receive coil.
- Whole-Body SAR ≤ 0.4 W/kg.
Before scanning, set the device configuration: Therapy OFF.
Scan regions: Any landmark is acceptable.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
